title: Resident Trust Fund Accounts: Interest Schedule by Account Tier
content:
Money a resident keeps with Keystone Ridge under the Resident Trust Fund Accounts earns interest in the pooled resident funds account once it rises above the interest-bearing threshold of the account's tier. The threshold is $50.00 for the three Medicaid tiers and $100.00 for the three Non-Medicaid tiers; every other interest term is the same for all six tiers.

## Interest terms per tier

| Tier | Interest-bearing threshold | Balance that earns interest | Day count | Credited | Rounding of a credit | Smallest credit posted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Self-Directed | $50.00 | average daily balance above the threshold | actual days in the month over 365 | monthly, on the last day of the month | half up to the cent | $0.01 |
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Representative Payee | $50.00 | average daily balance above the threshold | actual days in the month over 365 | monthly, on the last day of the month | half up to the cent | $0.01 |
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Guardianship | $50.00 | average daily balance above the threshold | actual days in the month over 365 | monthly, on the last day of the month | half up to the cent | $0.01 |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Self-Directed | $100.00 | average daily balance above the threshold | actual days in the month over 365 | monthly, on the last day of the month | half up to the cent | $0.01 |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Representative Payee | $100.00 | average daily balance above the threshold | actual days in the month over 365 | monthly, on the last day of the month | half up to the cent | $0.01 |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Guardianship | $100.00 | average daily balance above the threshold | actual days in the month over 365 | monthly, on the last day of the month | half up to the cent | $0.01 |

## Annual rate the depository pays

The rate is the annual percentage the center's depository pays on the pooled resident funds account, as published in the resident funds disclosure, and applies to all six tiers from its effective date:

| Effective from | Annual rate |
|---|---|
| 2025-01-01 | 0.5 percent per year |
| 2026-01-01 | 0.4 percent per year |

A month takes the rate in effect for that month.

## Reading the schedule

- **Which threshold?** The threshold of the tier in effect on the last day of the month governs the whole month.
- **Small credits.** A month whose credit rounds to less than $0.01 posts no interest credit.
- **Day count.** A 30-day month counts 30 days over 365; a 31-day month counts 31 days over 365; February counts its actual days.
